question: Build a balance-sheet comp table for four U.S. retailers: TJX Companies, Ross Stores, Lowe's and Tractor Supply. Use each company's latest reported balance sheet as of October 3, 2026 (the most recent 10-Q or 10-K) and state its balance-sheet date. Report, in USD millions: (1) cash and cash equivalents (exclude short-term investments and restricted cash); (2) total debt = current portion of long-term debt + long-term debt (non-current portion), as presented on the face of the balance sheet, excluding operating lease liabilities, separately presented finance lease liabilities and any commercial paper or short-term borrowings; (3) net debt = total debt - cash and cash equivalents (a negative number means net cash).
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Latest balance sheets (USD millions; negative net debt = net cash):

output.answer:
# Balance-Sheet Comp Table — U.S. Retailers

All figures in **USD millions**, taken from each company's most recent reported balance sheet (Q2 FY2026/FY2027 10-Qs).

| Company | Balance-Sheet Date | Cash & Cash Equivalents | Total Debt¹ | Net Debt / (Net Cash)² |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **TJX Companies (TJX)** | **August 1, 2026** | 6,004 | 2,871 | **(3,133)** |
| **Ross Stores (ROST)** | **August 1, 2026** | 4,288 | 1,019 | **(3,270)** |
| **Lowe's (LOW)** | **July 31, 2026** | 3,172 | 37,556 | **34,384** |
| **Tractor Supply (TSCO)** | **June 27, 2026** | 232 | 2,154 | **1,922** |

### Calculation detail

| Company | Cash & equiv. | Current portion LTD | LTD (non-current) | Total Debt | Net Debt |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| TJX | 6,004 | 1,000 | 1,871 | 2,871 | (3,133) |
| Ross Stores | 4,288 | 241 | 777 | 1,019 | (3,270) |
| Lowe's | 3,172 | 2,352 | 35,204 | 37,556 | 34,384 |
| Tractor Supply | 232 | 0 | 2,154 | 2,154 | 1,922 |

¹ Total debt = current portion of long-term debt + non-current long-term debt, **as presented on the face of the balance sheet**. It **excludes** operating lease liabilities, separately presented finance lease liabilities, and commercial paper/short-term borrowings, per your definition.
² Net debt = total debt − cash. Negative = net cash. Ross's cash figure excludes restricted cash ($68.8M); Lowe's excludes short-term investments ($235M).

### Notes / caveats
- **TJX** — As of Aug 1, 2026 there were no short-term borrowings or commercial paper outstanding. The $1,000M current portion is the 2.250% notes due Sept. 2026. Lease liabilities ($1,714M current + $9,732M non-current operating) are excluded. Cash excludes short-term investments.
- **Ross Stores** — Cash of $4,288M is the balance-sheet "cash and cash equivalents" line (excludes $68.8M restricted cash). Current portion is the 4.700% notes due 2027. No credit-facility borrowings outstanding. No separate finance lease line.
- **Lowe's** — Current maturities of long-term debt $2,352M + long-term debt (ex. current maturities) $35,204M. Excludes $380M short-term borrowings shown in Q1 (none on the Q2 face) and operating lease liabilities. Cash excludes $235M short-term investments. Note the total-debt figure here excludes finance leases separately presented in Lowe's lease footnote.
- **Tractor Supply** — No current portion of long-term debt ($0); face-of-balance-sheet long-term debt is $2,154M. Excludes finance lease liabilities ($10M current + $43M non-current) and operating lease liabilities ($464M current + $3,874M non-current), both separately presented.

**Sources:**
- TJX Q2 FY2027 report (period ended Aug 1, 2026): https://investor.tjx.com/news-releases/news-release-details/tjx-reports-q2-fy27-results-above-plan-comp-sales-growth-4 ; 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/109198/000010919826000048/tjx-20260801.htm
- Ross Stores Q2 FY2026 report (period ended Aug 1, 2026): https://investors.rossstores.com/news-releases/news-release-details/ross-stores-reports-strong-second-quarter-sales-and-earnings ; 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/745732/000074573226000041/rost-20260801.htm
- Lowe's Q2 FY2026 report (period ended July 31, 2026): https://corporate.lowes.com/newsroom/press-releases/lowes-reports-second-quarter-2026-sales-and-earnings-results-08-19-26
- Tractor Supply Q2 FY2026 report (period ended June 27, 2026): https://corporate.tractorsupply.com/newsroom/news-releases/news-releases-details/2026/Tractor-Supply-Company-Reports-Second-Quarter-2026-Financial-Results-Updates-Fiscal-Year-2026-Outlook/default.aspx ; 10-Q: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/916365/000091636526000059/tsco-20260627.htm
